certification_matrix.summary: Targeted canonical v5/v4/operator/reporting suites passed on this branch.
Promptset fail-closed, proof/report contract, and resume smoke suites stayed green.
Wrapper plane is inconsistent; dopemux truth is non-canonical and broken, and truth-run resume semantics drift.
questionary-backed UX surfaces are imported but questionary is not declared in pyproject.toml.
Core help surfaces are readable, but blocker visibility, wizard messaging, and dashboard portability are not certification-grade.
Theme defaults, brand docs, voice gates, and brand checklist do not agree on a production contract.
Text-first semantics exist, but blink-driven states and endpoint assumptions reduce clarity and accessibility.
brand_lint.py is not runnable on this checkout and pre-commit coverage is still docs-heavy.

command_authority_map.target: legacy group with mixed delegation to extractor runtimes
Textual TUI with hard-coded service URLs

code_findings.title: dopemux truth is a broken legacy path, not a production wrapper
code_findings.why_it_matters: Operators can invoke a command that claims extractor authority but does not use the canonical v5 runtime contract.
code_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Rewire dopemux truth to the canonical v5 wrapper or fail closed with an explicit legacy redirect.
code_findings.validation: Add a command-path test asserting canonical v5 delegation or explicit refusal.

code_findings.title: truth-run resume injects a fresh run id and defeats latest-run semantics
code_findings.why_it_matters: Resume semantics are contractual for run identity, checkpointing, and proof paths.
code_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: When --resume is set without an explicit --run-id, omit --run-id from the subprocess command.
code_findings.validation: Add wrapper tests that assert no --run-id is passed in the implicit-resume case.

code_findings.title: Wizard and interactive UX paths depend on undeclared questionary
code_findings.why_it_matters: Key operator flows fail before their own health checks, which blocks install integrity and UX certification.
code_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Declare questionary or move to tested lazy imports with explicit fallback/refusal behavior.
code_findings.validation: Clean-environment import smoke for all operator surfaces.

code_findings.title: brand_lint.py is not a usable certification gate on this checkout
code_findings.why_it_matters: A broken gate cannot be counted as release evidence.
code_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Repair the syntax error first, then treat brand lint as a real release gate.

code_findings.title: Rich validation UI hides blocker detail that plain mode preserves
code_findings.why_it_matters: The richer UI path should not reduce operator access to blocker truth.
code_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Render all blockers plus next actions in rich mode.

code_findings.title: Wizard extraction copy says hygiene is performed while forcing --skip-hygiene
code_findings.why_it_matters: Safety copy and actual behavior diverge in a guided operator flow.
code_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Align the help copy with the actual flags or stop forcing --skip-hygiene.
code_findings.validation: Wizard command-assembly test and transcript smoke.

ux_findings.title: Production brand authority is split across incompatible docs and runtime gates
ux_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Adopt Operational Mint Production as the runtime authority and scope spicier voice to non-critical surfaces.

ux_findings.title: Theme defaults do not match the documented production palette
ux_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Make mint-mojo the default production theme and treat other palettes as opt-in themes.

ux_findings.title: Launcher wizard bypasses shared theme and style rules
ux_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Move the launcher wizard onto shared theme tokens, console, and status chips.

ux_findings.title: Dashboard surfaces are visually strong but topology-bound and motion-heavy
ux_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Externalize endpoints, add connection age/source labels, and reduce blink-driven state signaling.

ux_findings.title: Brand compliance checklist is merge-corrupted
ux_findings.recommended_minimal_fix: Resolve conflict markers and reduce the checklist to current production assertions only.
